spells.name: Enchant Weapon: Power
spells.body:
As a *Half Action* enchant your weapon for your next **3** attacks/spell casts. Gain the following effects while enchanted depending on the weapon type:

**Melee**: Enchanted Melee weapons gain **+1** to **Dice Tier** to their base damage. Increase by an additional **+1** at Player Levels 6, 12 and 18.

**Ranged**: Enchanted Ranged weapons gain **+1** to **Dice Tier** to their base damage. Increase by an additional **+1** at Player Levels 6, 12 and 18.

**Spell Focus**: Enhance spells gain **+4m** to range. Enchanted Spell Attacks again **+1d8** to Attack rolls.
